Mother foreground holds smartphone naturally to her ear calling her adult child, concerned but composed; father slightly behind at kitchen counter looking down into open drawer searching for flashlight. No flashlight found, no candles, no extra people. Candid imperfect smartphone detail, subtle grain, normal depth of field, no glossy advertising lighting, no dramatic horror, anatomically natural hands, no wood boards obstructing people.

No numbered markers, no website UI, no text overlays. Do not invent large equipment, food, water, batteries or medicines. Reference screenshot is for actual objects only.
